name: sfvictorian-opus
summary:
SF Italianate painted lady on a 16x50 lot: a teal-siding false front over a dark-teal garage base, with a full-height angled bay (x1..6) and a cream stair rising to a recessed columned porch (x10..14). Gold fish-scale bands, a burgundy frieze and a deep bracketed cream cornice sit under a pedimented parapet that hides a low `shop`-preset gable.
Ochre and pale-blue neighbours press against both sides. A lightwell lights the dining room and bath, one long staircase runs up the east party wall, and the kitchen opens onto a deck above a deep garden with a citrus tree, a veg bed and a bench. (21 of 21 parts finished)
